summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 to ControlType and a (ControlType, str) form to the ControlCode union; rich/control.py adds the formatting entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and Control.title(title) with docstring; rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool after show_cursor, buffering the control only when is_terminal is true, with docstring; rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200; tests added in tests/test_console.py (skipped on win32), tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py (win32 only). Nothing was run or formatted with Black, per instructions, so test results and formatting are unverified. No commits were made.
